{{Quote|Buh-bye, now|[[Kyle Katarn]]|<ref name="Equals & Opposites">{{Tales|21|Equals & Opposites}}</ref>}}
A '''battle''' occurred on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Ord Sedra]] during the [[Yuuzhan Vong War]], the defeat of a slave-raiding group by [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] [[Kyle Katarn]], [[New Republic Intelligence Service|New Republic Intelligence]] agent [[Jan Ors]], and [[Lieutenant/Legends|Lieutenant]] [[Pallin]] of the [[Imperial Army/Legends|Imperial Army]].

==Background==
The [[Yuuzhan Vong]] and [[Peace Brigade]] conquered [[Ord Sedra]], a backwater world in the [[Imperial Remnant/Legends|Imperial Remnant]], and took the planet's population as slaves. Ors, Pallin, and Katarn led a force of [[Stormtrooper/Legends|stormtroopers]] to stop a convoy of Brigade slave traders led by a Yuuzhan Vong warlord.

==The battle==
While [[Pallin]] and his stormtroopers engaged the alien invaders, Jan and Kyle went to the nearby village to gear up. Kyle received a distress signal from the Lieutenant&mdash;his forces were being destroyed. Jan immediately rushed to the scene and was taken captive by the Vong warlord.

Kyle, worried for Ors, arrived at the scene to find a large amount the forces dead. He went into the nearby village and found Jan in a prison cell guarded by the Warlord. Kyle gave Ors his [[Lightsaber/Legends|lightsaber]] to slice her way out of the cell while he engaged the Vong. Katarn used an [[Bomb/Legends|explosive]] to stab and impale the Vong in the chest, and kicked him out the window, where the Vong exploded.

==Aftermath==
The slave trade was stopped, the Warlord was dead, and the [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]] was victorious.
